images.filename: Leadville Colorado by Boston & Ziegler c1880.png
images.caption: Circa 1880 Cabinet Card Photograph of the Silver Mining Boomtown of Leadville, Colorado. This wonderful, Card Mount Photograph is titled in manuscript on the reverse “Capitol Hill Leadville". Bird's-eye-view of the Mining Boomtown of Leadville, Colorado. The Image looks down on the center of Leadville with the "Eighth Avenue Motel" visible at the center of the Photo. Extensive mining works can be seen on the hill that raises on the far side of the Town. Four boys are visible in the foreground.
